preconditions.description: Input integers n and k must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 and 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^6.
Input must contain exactly two integers separated by whitespace.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > n * n else True
postconditions.description: If k exceeds the total possible cells (n²), output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == '1' if (i == j and k > 0) else True for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) if k > 0 else True
postconditions.description: If k > 0, the diagonal cells must be prioritized for placing '1's to maximize lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == stdout.splitlines()[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: The output matrix must be symmetric with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: sum(sum(1 for c in row if c == '1') for row in stdout.splitlines()) == k if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: The total number of '1's in the output matrix must equal k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in stdout.splitlines()) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: Each row in the output matrix must have exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for row in stdout.splitlines() for c in row) if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: The output matrix must contain only '0's and '1's.
